_comment: How the build and report-name-quality.mjs treat all-caps code-like names (isCode in bucket-names.mjs). Two reviewed lists; anything in neither the report flags as a new, unreviewed case. `legit` = a genuine colloquial abbreviation, correct on Wikidata as a short name, so the report stays quiet — it also enters the word list, but only if it clears the skribbl-suitability rule (3+ letters, letters only: U.S. / HK / UK are legit yet stay out of lists). `acknowledged` = reviewed and not whitelisted (an ISO or technical code Wikidata mis-files under P1813, a shouty all-caps official name, or just too rare to use); the report stays quiet and it never enters a list. Extend both from the report and _untracked/Prompts/Whitelist_Colloquial_Abbreviations.md; report-name-quality.mjs flags acknowledged entries the data no longer carries, so a Wikidata fix lets them be removed.
